title: A costume in motion
alt: A woman in an ivory blouse and a red pleated skirt changes from a standing portrait to a dance pose.
description: An identity-preserving pose edit with natural hands, leg movement and flowing fabric.

frames.label: Input
frames.prompt: A full-length fine-art fashion photograph of an adult East Asian woman standing naturally in a quiet dark rehearsal studio. She wears an ivory long-sleeved blouse with a bow at the neck, a structured ruby-red pleated skirt ending below the knee, dark ankle boots and two small round gold earrings. Her black hair is tied in a low bun. Her hands rest naturally at her sides. A long horizontal wooden ballet barre and a single tall window are visible behind her. Realistic face and anatomy, beautiful fabric detail, restrained theatrical light, no text.

frames.label: Result
frames.prompt: Keep the exact same adult woman, face, hairstyle, gold earrings, ivory bow blouse, ruby pleated skirt, boots and rehearsal room. Change her pose into a graceful mid-turn dance movement: one foot remains on the floor, the other bends slightly behind, both arms open outward, and the same pleated skirt flares naturally with the rotation. Show anatomically correct hands and legs, convincing fabric motion and grounded shadow. Preserve the camera framing and original window light.
